Account.definition: A durable canonical identity for a legal entity, operating company, business unit, or other selling-relevant organization.
Account.purpose: Unifies company representations while keeping parents and subsidiaries distinct.
Account.history: Identity is durable; mutable names, domains, hierarchy, and selected lifecycle facts are effective-dated in related structures.
Account.source_relationship: Mapped from zero or more SourceRecords through ExternalIdentityCrosswalk.

Person.definition: One durable canonical identity for a human across sources, lifecycle stages, and employers.
Person.purpose: Prevents Lead, Contact, and product-user representations from duplicating a human identity.
Person.history: Identity persists; employer history is held in AccountPersonRelationship and source representations in the crosswalk.
Person.source_relationship: Lead, Contact, marketing, support, and product records map through the crosswalk; unresolved records remain source-only.

AccountPersonRelationship.definition: An effective-dated affiliation between a Person and an Account, such as employment, advisory, or executive sponsorship.
AccountPersonRelationship.purpose: Preserves employer and role history without changing Person identity.
AccountPersonRelationship.history: Effective-dated; non-overlap is expected for the same person/account/type when marked primary.
AccountPersonRelationship.source_relationship: Derived from source employment or account-contact associations with provenance retained.

Opportunity.definition: A canonical potential commercial transaction with exactly one primary buying Account.
Opportunity.purpose: Provides the shared revenue-pipeline identity independent of CRM object IDs.
Opportunity.history: Canonical identity is stable; stage and amount history are deferred to a later analytical design.

OpportunityPersonRole.definition: A Person's role and participation in a specific Opportunity.
OpportunityPersonRole.purpose: Models multi-person buying committees without embedding participant columns on Opportunity.
OpportunityPersonRole.history: Effective-dated so changing buying roles remain auditable.
OpportunityPersonRole.source_relationship: CRM opportunity-contact roles and inferred roles retain provenance.

Activity.definition: A business interaction or event such as an email, meeting, call, form submission, or product-related touch.
Activity.purpose: Provides a common interaction envelope while Campaign and ProductUser stay distinct concepts.
Activity.history: Append-oriented; corrections create auditable revisions rather than erasing the original event.
Activity.source_relationship: May remain unresolved with only source_record_id and resolution_status populated.

Campaign.definition: A canonical marketing or coordinated outreach initiative.
Campaign.purpose: Groups attributable interactions and spend without treating campaigns as activities.
Campaign.history: Identity is stable; material status changes remain available through source history or future snapshots.

Quote.definition: A priced commercial proposal issued for an Opportunity and buying Account.
Quote.purpose: Separates offer versions from Opportunities and resulting Contracts or Orders.
Quote.history: Each commercial revision is independently versioned; accepted facts are not overwritten.
Quote.source_relationship: CPQ and CRM quote objects map through ExternalIdentityCrosswalk.

Contract.definition: A legally binding commercial agreement with an Account.
Contract.purpose: Retains agreement identity, term, and status independently from Account customer status and subscriptions.
Contract.history: Amendments and renewals link to independent Contract identities; executed terms are immutable except audited correction.
Contract.source_relationship: CLM, CRM, or billing contracts map through ExternalIdentityCrosswalk.

Order.definition: An accepted request to provision or fulfill purchased products or services.
Order.purpose: Bridges signed commercial intent to fulfillment and billing.
Order.history: Order status transitions are audit events; the accepted order identity remains stable.
Order.source_relationship: ERP, CPQ, and billing order objects map through ExternalIdentityCrosswalk.

Subscription.definition: A time-bounded entitlement to a recurring product or service for an Account.
Subscription.purpose: Tracks recurring service independently from its Contract and the Account's lifecycle label.
Subscription.history: Terms and status changes are effective-dated or represented as amendments in the future physical model.
Subscription.source_relationship: Billing and entitlement subscriptions map through ExternalIdentityCrosswalk.

Invoice.definition: A billing demand issued to an Account for an Order, Contract, or Subscription obligation.
Invoice.purpose: Provides independent receivable identity and payment-state context.
Invoice.history: Issued invoices are append-oriented; voids, credits, and corrections remain auditable.
Invoice.source_relationship: Billing and ERP invoices map through ExternalIdentityCrosswalk.

ProductUser.definition: A product-system user profile linked when resolvable to one canonical Person and relevant Account context.
ProductUser.purpose: Keeps application tenancy and usage identity distinct from the human's canonical identity.
ProductUser.history: Source profile state changes are retained by source snapshots; canonical links are auditable through the crosswalk.
ProductUser.source_relationship: Represents a product source profile and may remain unresolved.

SupportCase.definition: A customer support request or incident associated with relevant account, person, and product context.
SupportCase.purpose: Makes service experience available without conflating a case with an interaction or signal.
SupportCase.history: Case identity is stable; source audit history supplies status transitions until a later event model is approved.

Signal.definition: A derived, time-stamped observation relevant to a canonical entity, such as intent, risk, engagement, or data-quality state.
Signal.purpose: Carries explainable derived observations without mutating canonical entities.
Signal.history: Append-only and versioned by derivation logic; expiry does not delete the observation.
Signal.source_relationship: Derived from source or canonical facts with lineage references defined in later pipeline phases.

EnrichmentSnapshot.definition: A point-in-time capture of third-party or internal enrichment attributes for a canonical subject.
EnrichmentSnapshot.purpose: Preserves provider response, observation time, and provenance without overwriting canonical truth.
EnrichmentSnapshot.history: Immutable snapshot; newer responses create new rows.
EnrichmentSnapshot.source_relationship: Provider request/response identifiers and licensing constraints must remain traceable.

Decision.definition: An auditable machine or human decision made about a business subject.
Decision.purpose: Explains what was decided, by which policy or actor, from which evidence, without embedding workflow logic in entities.
Decision.history: Append-only; superseding decisions reference earlier decisions rather than updating them away.
Decision.source_relationship: May be produced by a future workflow, analyst, or source system with evidence lineage.

WorkflowRun.definition: One execution attempt of an automated or human-assisted revenue workflow.
WorkflowRun.purpose: Provides idempotency, execution lineage, failure visibility, and recovery context.
WorkflowRun.history: Each attempt is immutable; retries are new linked runs.
WorkflowRun.source_relationship: Operational metadata generated by future pipelines and automations.

ExternalIdentityCrosswalk.definition: An auditable, effective-dated mapping from a SourceRecord to one canonical entity.
ExternalIdentityCrosswalk.purpose: Decouples source identifiers from canonical IDs and supports remapping or manual correction without rewriting history.
ExternalIdentityCrosswalk.history: Append-only/effective-dated; corrections close the prior mapping and create a superseding row.
ExternalIdentityCrosswalk.source_relationship: Authoritative source-to-canonical linkage for all supported entity types.

SourceRecord.definition: A stable reference to one object as represented in one source system and source tenant.
SourceRecord.purpose: Preserves provenance and permits unresolved records without copying full raw payloads into the canonical contract.
SourceRecord.history: Reference identity is stable for the source natural key; raw versions are retained by later ingestion storage design.
SourceRecord.source_relationship: Lead and Contact are represented as source_object_type values (for example salesforce_lead and salesforce_contact), not canonical entities.

AccountHierarchyRelationship.definition: An effective-dated directed relationship between two distinct canonical Accounts.
AccountHierarchyRelationship.purpose: Represents parent/subsidiary and other organizational structures without merging account identities.
AccountHierarchyRelationship.history: Effective-dated; self-links and cycles are invalid, and prior parents remain historical.
AccountHierarchyRelationship.source_relationship: Asserted by sources or stewardship with provenance.

AccountNameHistory.definition: An effective-dated official name, trade name, or alias for an Account.
AccountNameHistory.purpose: Supports name changes and alternate names without changing Account identity.
AccountNameHistory.history: Effective-dated selective SCD2; only one preferred name should be active per Account.
AccountNameHistory.source_relationship: Names retain source or stewardship provenance.

AccountDomainHistory.definition: An effective-dated normalized internet domain associated with an Account.
AccountDomainHistory.purpose: Supports domain changes and multiple domains without treating a domain as permanent account identity.
AccountDomainHistory.history: Effective-dated selective SCD2; domains can be reassigned only with non-overlapping evidence and audit history.
AccountDomainHistory.source_relationship: Domains retain observed-source or stewardship provenance.

relationships.rule: Every Opportunity has exactly one primary Account.

invariants: Canonical identifiers never embed source-system identifiers.
Lead and Contact are SourceRecord object types and never canonical Person subtypes.
An active crosswalk row maps one SourceRecord to at most one canonical entity at a time.
A Person may have many historical Account affiliations.
An Opportunity has exactly one primary buying Account.
Account hierarchy parent and child identities remain distinct.
Customer status is an Account lifecycle attribute, not a separate entity.
Unresolved source records and activities are preserved without fabricated canonical links.
Temporal rows use half-open validity intervals: valid_from inclusive, valid_to exclusive; null valid_to means current.
Corrections and retries supersede or link prior records instead of erasing audit history.
